text_en: The  MDTS was adopted by Government in September 2023 and with an aim of supporting Moldova’s efforts in achieving the UN Sustainable Development Goals and aligning with existing European policies and standards in the digital field.

text_en: One of the main objectives of the strategy is the digitalization of public services, and the results achieved in 2023 show significant progress in this respect: both the increase in the percentage of digitalized public services and the number of requests for e-services for the business environment (70%).

Two (2) out of three (3) entrepreneurs prefer to use online services and only 30% of requests are still in-person.
